text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the halfway point of the training camp.
On this day, I was timing Sakura Chiyono O,
just as we had promised before the camp.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
How's... the time looking?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I compare the past records on the binder
with the newly measured time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Did I break the record!? Could it be faster than this spring...!?
choice_data_list: ...I think it's the same time as the end of last year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see. I get it now~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Improving yourself is
surprisingly difficult, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack... crack)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I felt that sensation again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm becoming so fragile. Cracks are forming everywhere. I feel like I can never go back to the person I used to be—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —I'm scared.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...What if the current me
were to race against Maruzen-san?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Maruzen-san will probably break away on a solo lead.
I will watch her from within the leading pack."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No one can reach Maruzen-san's position.
But right around the third corner,
I'll launch my spurt!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Gradually building up to top speed,
I steadily close the distance between myself and Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And now the final stretch! The ultimate battle of speed.
I squeeze out every last ounce of strength in my body and push forward.
I can do this—I'm closing in on Maruzen-san's back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san glanced over at me!
Yes, our one-on-one duel starts now! With all my strength, my legs—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —The foot I took a step with gave out completely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack-crack...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much strength I muster,
it slips away as if draining from a fragile, broken body...
I'm overtaken by the others and left in their dust.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot reach.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
……! Like this……
I can't be a worthy rival……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training began, Sakura Chiyono O's expression
looked unusually gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'm sure it won't
hinder my training at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Cheers...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san!
Are you here to watch as well?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"It seems Ardan-san is having a race
with Bamboo-san!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew... haaah...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...She's pretty good, huh...
To think she'd pull that off right after coming back...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(—Ardan-san won.
Against Bamboo-san, who was in top form...
Right after making her comeback...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah. U-Umm, congratulations,
Ardan-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Thank you very much.
Mejiro Ardan has returned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The regret I received from you...
and the desire not to lose gave me strength and guided me all the way here."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of you, Ardan-san.
However, as you know,
Chiyono O-san is a formidable opponent.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Having competed against her so much,
I know her strength all too well.
The next "Tenno Sho (Autumn)" will be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... will you be running?
You're entering the Autumn Tenno Sho too, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So if I run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
I'll be able to compete with everyone
just like back at the Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (I was supposed to have felt that exact same way after the Derby.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I crossed the finish line at the end...
I found myself wishing this time would never end."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to keep competing forever, as their rival.
I want to keep running on and on,’ she said."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Hah... It's finally... over...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Weighed down by my body, I feel like
even that spirit is beginning to fade...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Ardan-san hasn't lost anything
compared to before.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ......No way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Yaeno-san isn't like me either.
Neither of those two are on the decline.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No... please, no...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I'm no longer the Sakura Chiyono O
from that Derby...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san!?

...Wait, everyone.
Leave her to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Why did I――
Why――...ugh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*, *pant*...

Phew~ I finally caught up!
Chiyo-chan, you just wouldn't stop at all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san...?
What brings you here...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~, the answer is~...
Because I've always been watching you, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, everyone was bewildered, you know?
Dashing off so suddenly right in the middle of talking to your friends.
Say, Chiyo-chan. Are you...?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be that my peak has passed?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? How do you know about that...!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As for this answer, maybe it's
because I know what that feeling is like too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not true. There's no way you could
understand that feeling, Maruzen-san. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san!! Is it true that you won by a whopping seven lengths in your first mock race in a long time!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was watching, after all.
Seeing you overcome that hiatus without breaking a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's incredible, isn't it... A concept like "peaking" will never apply to Maruzen-san in her entire life.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"You really are special, after all.
Unlike me, you have a special talent—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That is not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you felt like your old self was slowly crumbling away, didn't you?
Like you'd never be able to go back to how things were."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Kh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, bingo, perhaps?
Then we really are the same. I pushed myself
trying to reach my prime years too, you see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yet I couldn't go back.
I could never get back that running style, or the body I had back then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"This feeling... it's amazing...!
Not bad at all—in fact—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if that is lost,
I will keep running as the me I am now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because the fire to never lose to a rival like you
is burning inside my heart.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, rivals truly are amazing.
To think I'd hate losing this much.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"A broken glass can never be restored to its original state.
I knew full well that repairing it was impossible."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I knew it, but I didn't want to admit it. That's why it was pure stubbornness. By sticking to my pride, I took back who I truly am.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I might be different from before, but I want to be a version of myself that won't lose to the old me, either.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Chiyo-chan. You have a rival right in front of you—me. Is your heart not burning anymore?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Because these are feelings you taught me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"And I proved it.
That as long as I have these feelings,
there's nothing I can't overcome."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Hey, that's why, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I'll be waiting for you.
At Tokyo Turf 2400m—our Derby,
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My precious rival!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...You're sweating like crazy.
Just how far did you run?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm sorry to have worried you.
But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...My mind is made up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think I can ever go back
to the person I used to be."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No... that's precisely why.
I want to face that reality head-on.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo-chan, don't feel anxious.
You will definitely overcome this in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even though pieces of me are gradually chipping away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I have to search for what I should be doing right now, for a way I can fight.
Because...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Because I refuse to lose to my rival...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having accepted the present, the setting sun shone dazzlingly bright in Sakura Chiyono O's eyes.
